typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT DISTINCT  	 H.CALLLIST_335_HISTORY_CASE_ID AS CASE_ID 	,CS.CALLLISTSTATUS_AGENT as AGENT_ID 	,M.MEMBER_FIRST_NAME + \' \' + M.MEMBER_LAST_NAME as [MEMBER_NAME] 	,M.MEMBER_BIRTH_DT as MEMBER_DOB 	,CAST(LEFT(convert(date,H.CALLLIST_335_HISTORY_CASE_CREATE_DATE), 4)+right(left(convert(date,H.CALLLIST_335_HISTORY_CASE_CREATE_DATE),7),2)+ 				 right(convert(date,H.CALLLIST_335_HISTORY_CASE_CREATE_DATE),2) AS VARCHAR(80))AS CASE_CREATION_DATE 	,ICR.CALLLISTRULE_CD as [SCRUB_RULE_CD] 	,ICR.CALLLISTRULE_DESC as [SCRUB_RULE_DESCRIPTION] 	,DC.DISPOSITIONCODE_CD as DISPOSITIONCODE 	,DC.DISPOSITIONCODE_DESCRIPTION as DISPOSITIONCODE_DESCRIPTION FROM PDS_CALLLIST CL INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTDATE CD ON CL.CALLLIST_IID = CD.CALLLISTDATE_CALLLIST_IID            INNER JOIN  ( 		SELECT MAX(CD.CALLLISTDATE_IID) AS MAX_CALLLISTDATE_IID  		FROM PDS_CALLLIST CL INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTDATE CD ON CL.CALLLIST_CD = \'343\'  				AND CD.CALLLISTDATE_CALLLIST_IID = CL.CALLLIST_IID ) MAXCD ON  CD.CALLLISTDATE_IID =MAXCD.MAX_CALLLISTDATE_IID	         INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTMASTER CM ON MAXCD.MAX_CALLLISTDATE_IID = CM.CALLLISTMASTER_CALLLISTDATE_IID INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTRULE ICR ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_INACTIVE_CALLLISTRULE_IID = ICR.CALLLISTRULE_IID     INNER JOIN PDS_MEMBER M ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_ENTITY_IID = M.MEMBER_IID LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_CALLLIST_335_HISTORY_TASKS CCNT  ON CCNT.CALLLIST_335_HISTORY_TASK_IID = CM.CALLLISTMASTER_EXTRADATA_IID AND CL.CALLLIST_CD =\'343\' LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_CALLLIST_335_HISTORY H  ON H.CALLLIST_335_HISTORY_CASE_IID = COALESCE(CCNT.CALLLIST_335_HISTORY_TASK_CASE_IID,CM.CALLLISTMASTER_EXTRADATA_IID) AND CL.CALLLIST_CD =\'343\' LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTSTATUS CS ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_ENTITY_IID = CS.CALLLISTSTATUS_ENTITY_IID 		AND CL.CALLLIST_IID = CS.CALLLISTSTATUS_CALLLIST_IID LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_DISPOSITIONCODE DC ON CS.CALLLISTSTATUS_LASTDISPOSITIONCODE_IID = DC.DISPOSITIONCODE_IID WHERE CL.CALLLIST_CD = \'343\'',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		AGENT_ID as string,
		MEMBER_NAME as string,
		CASE_ID as string,
		DISPOSITIONCODE_DESCRIPTION as string,
		SCRUB_RULE_CD as string,
		SCRUB_RULE_DESCRIPTION as string,
		DISPOSITIONCODE as string,
		CASE_CREATION_DATE as string,
		MEMBER_DOB as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		AGENT_ID,
		MEMBER_NAME,
		CASE_ID,
		DISPOSITIONCODE_DESCRIPTION,
		SCRUB_RULE_CD,
		SCRUB_RULE_DESCRIPTION,
		DISPOSITIONCODE,
		CASE_CREATION_DATE,
		MEMBER_DOB)) ~> FlatFileDestination
